description: True cold launch x5, realistic profile (24 seeded workspaces, a split and an agent chat): the daemon stopped and the file cache purged (sudo -n purge, decision D3) right before each launch; process start to the first window frame and the first live terminal frame. The launch.cold target is judged on the empty profile (launch-cold). A host without the purge right refuses with sudo's reason and writes nothing.
